描述_EN: A copy of the Forty-two Chapters Sutra (Daikaku Seonji, 1213-78) by Doyo Lanxi. The sutra contains forty-two precepts to be observed by Buddhist followers in their practice and daily life, and is highly valued in Zen Buddhism in China and Japan. In 1246, Lan Kwai Fong came to Japan from the Southern Song Dynasty and took refuge under Tokiyori Hojo, who became the founder of Kenchōji Temple. The influence of another Southern Song calligrapher, Zhang Jizhi (1186 - 1266), can be seen in his handwriting. A separate inscription indicates that it was given to a man named Shoutoku in July 1276.
描述_ZN: 兰溪道友抄写的四十二章经（Daikaku Seonji，1213-78）。 该经包含了佛教信徒在修行和日常生活中应遵守的四十二条戒律，在中国和日本的禅宗中受到高度重视。 1246年，兰桂坊从南宋来到日本，在北条时赖手下避难，成为建昌寺的创始人。 从他的笔迹中可以看出南宋另一位书法家张继之（1186 - 1266）的影响。 一个单独的铭文表明，它是在1276年7月送给一个叫Shoutoku的人。
